title: Uniform C¹ approximation of compactly supported continuous fields inside an open set (mollification)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N be continuous with compact support, and let W ⊆ ℝ^N be open with tsupport g ⊆ W. Then there are a compact set K with tsupport g ⊆ K ⊆ W and C¹ maps h_k : ℝ^N → ℝ^N (k ∈ ℕ), each with compact support and tsupport h_k ⊆ K, such that h_k → g uniformly on ℝ^N as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : Rn N → Rn N) (W : Set (Rn N)), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → IsOpen W → tsupport g ⊆ W → ∃ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K ∧ tsupport g ⊆ K ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ ∃ h : ℕ → Rn N → Rn N, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (h k) ∧ tsupport (h k) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly h g atTop
